d: Addressing a press briefing, All India Students' Association (AISA) president Neha Bora scrutinised the counter-affidavit submitted by the Election Commission of India (ECI) before the Supreme Court regarding the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) process. Bora countered the official claim that major decisions were taken unanimously, asserting that internal communications and objections raised by Election Commissioners over ten months demonstrated otherwise.
